owner: ADVI_BILLING (AB-e-5 writes it; AB-e-6 fee_quarter v2 reads it)
grain: one row per Schwab master-0833 account in the latest fact_acc partition (schwab_account_number is unique)
read_rule: a reader takes the newest date= partition

schwab_account_number.meaning: Schwab custodian account number, 10 digits zero padded; every value exists in fact_acc

bd_account_id.meaning: Black Diamond account id (z + 10 digits) whose allocations row carries this custodian number; null when unmatched

bd_relationship_id.meaning: Black Diamond relationship id (z-form) = the portal's client key = the name of the served platinum client summary; from the allocations row, else the BD accounts dimension; null when unmatched

opal_relationship_id.meaning: Opal dim_relationship relationship_id (rel_<hex>) of the newest partition for this account where mapped is true; null when none. Independent of the BD match

match_method.meaning: how the BD side was reached. allocations_number = the allocations account_number, zero padded to 10, equals the Schwab account; allocations_original_number = only the original_account_number does (tried when the first did not reach fact_acc); unmatched = neither does

claim.meaning: measured = the BD side was read from a named allocations row; absent = no BD value could be had (match_method unmatched). A consumer rejects on this field

inputs.allocations: BD silver allocations, newest <date> partition (account_id, account_number, original_account_number, relationship_id)
inputs.spine: BD accounts_dimension_latest (account_id -> relationship_id; no custodian number); fills a relationship the allocations row lacks
inputs.schwab_universe: Schwab master 0833 silver fact_acc, newest date= partition
inputs.client_keys: the z-form sub-prefixes of the served platinum clients prefix

digits_rule: a custodian cell is used only when it is a plain run of at most 10 digits (strip, zero pad to 10); masked or text cells ('****1234', names) are never parsed
scope_note: the object lists Schwab accounts only: a BD account with no custodian number at Schwab 0833 has no row
